{"as_of":"2026-11-14","question":"What did automated electricity meters report periodically, and who received those reports?","requests":[{"component_id":"r1","question_anchor":"What did automated electricity meters report periodically"},{"component_id":"r2","question_anchor":"who received those reports?"}],"evidence":[{"source_id":"eia-measurement","title":"Measuring electricity","url":"https://www.eia.gov/energyexplained/electricity/measuring-electricity.php","published":null,"doc_name":"eia-measuring.html","page_num":null,"spans":[{"span_id":"s_bc68aaf38aed223e","text":"Electricity is measured in units of power called Watts, named after James Watt, the inventor of the steam engine."},{"span_id":"s_a46000abe7f383a1","text":"One Watt is a very small amount of power."},{"span_id":"s_6531c20764810d19","text":"Some devices need only a few Watts to operate, but other devices require larger amounts, and their consumption is measured in kilowatts (kW)."},{"span_id":"s_d46a265266fdb8bc","text":"One kilowatt is equal to 1,000 Watts."},{"span_id":"s_d1ad042cf9ed1c0a","text":"For very large amounts of electricity, like what power plants generate, we use even larger units:
Megawatts (MW): One MW is 1,000 kW, or 1,000,000 Watts."},{"span_id":"s_a0ba37a9ebb6f10b","text":"Gigawatts (GW): One GW is 1,000 MW, or 1,000,000,000 Watts."},{"span_id":"s_f771166ff784ccaf","text":"Electricity use over time is measured in Watthours
Watts measure power at a specific moment, but we use Watthours (Wh) to measure how much electricity is used over a period of time."},{"span_id":"s_ec39d28380e76dfd","text":"One Watthour is the energy of one Watt used for one hour."},{"span_id":"s_71e744b8dcea4eb6","text":"Electric utilities and power plants generally measure electricity in kilowatthours (kWh)."},{"span_id":"s_684693c6816ddcf4","text":"One kWh is one kilowatt generated for one hour."},{"span_id":"s_bd057ec120f8b36b","text":"For example, if you use a 40-Watt (0.04 kW) light bulb for five hours, you have used 200 Wh, or 0.2 kWh, of electrical energy."},{"span_id":"s_2845cfa10cf8e534","text":"Utility companies measure and monitor electricity use with meters
Electric utility companies use meters to measure how much electricity their customers use."},{"span_id":"s_f4366d86d82e2ee4","text":"These meters are usually located on the outside of the building or home where the power line connects."},{"span_id":"s_5b17f78fd492302c","text":"In the past, electricity meters were mechanical devices that a utility employee had to read manually."},{"span_id":"s_6af27ac482a98ade","text":"Eventually, automated meters could periodically report electricity use to the utility."},{"span_id":"s_ad16cc6c657b8bd0","text":"Today, many utilities use
electronic smart meters
."},{"span_id":"s_792c4494ed697e52","text":"These meters wirelessly send power usage data in real time."},{"span_id":"s_44a4448281bbe6a8","text":"Some advanced smart meters can even track the electricity use of individual devices and allow the utility or customer to control electricity use remotely."}]},{"source_id":"eia-generation-2023","title":"US utility-scale generation in 2023; preliminary February 2024 data","url":"https://www.eia.gov/tools/faqs/faq.php?id=427&t=3","published":"2024-02-29","doc_name":"eia-generation.html","page_num":null,"spans":[{"span_id":"s_9f6629387f7fb9e1","text":"In 2023, about 4,178 billion kilowatthours (kWh) (or about 4.18 trillion kWh) of electricity were generated at utility-scale electricity generation facilities in the United States."},{"span_id":"s_9f96e1da2a50533f","text":"1
About 60% of this electricity generation was from fossil fuels—coal, natural gas, petroleum, and other gases."},{"span_id":"s_610d409a2f28f88c","text":"About 19% was from nuclear energy, and about 21% was from renewable energy sources."},{"span_id":"s_31e68c934e4613b5","text":"The U.S."},{"span_id":"s_2259500935f03130","text":"Energy Information Administration estimates that an additional 73.62 billion kWh of electricity generation was from small-scale solar photovoltaic systems in 2023."},{"span_id":"s_5afda567c1ab8363","text":"2
